what: every level of the frame this batch was drawn from, with the stratum it was cut into. The draw record freezes each stratum's N and inclusion probability; this says WHICH level is in which stratum, so more panels can be added to the same strata without recutting deciles from a score file.
written_by: pipeline/draw_batch.py frame_strata is what reads it; written once, by hand, against the frozen record (docs/DECISIONS.md)
key: (WMO, CYCLE_NUMBER, PRES) with PRES = round(PRES_ADJUSTED); sorted by that key
decile_rule: eddy_pump.batches.score_deciles: rank of `score` over the WHOLE pool, ties broken by (WMO, CYCLE_NUMBER, PRES_ADJUSTED), rank * 10 // len(pool)
score_bounds_check: the 20 per-decile score_min/score_max the draw record froze, compared with the same bounds recut here: every one equal to the last bit (largest relative difference 0.0). The score VALUES are the August ones; only the parquet bytes moved.
how_it_was_made: cut on 2026-09-07 from this repository's current downward score file, which reproduces the 2026-08-27 downward cut: all ten decile counts and all 792 sampled rows' strata match the frozen record. The deciles were recut with eddy_pump.batches.score_deciles over the whole 133,307-level pool, exactly as production/build_batches.py did at archive commit cc5709f.
